        # Color 1: (01)
        # Color 2: (10)

        # Use ancilla to store result of comparison

        qc.ccx(problem_qubits[2*v1], problem_qubits[2*v1+1], ancilla)
        
        # Load color 0 check for v2 into ancilla

        # Load color 1 check for v1 into ancilla

        # Load color 1 check for v2 into ancilla

        # Load color 2 check for v1 into ancilla
        qc.cx(problem_qubits[2*v1+1], ancilla)
        
        # Load color 2 check for v2 into ancilla
        qc.cx(problem_qubits[2*v2+1], ancilla)

        qc.mcx([problem_qubits[2*v1], problem_qubits[2*v1+1], problem_qubits[2*v2], problem_qubits[2*v2+1]], ancilla)

    # Uncompute all ancillas to |0>

        qc.ccx(q0, q1, anc)  # If q0 is 1 and q1 is 1, anc will be 0 (color 3 -> 0)

    def compare_colors(anc1, anc2, result_anc):

def build_oracle(qc: QuantumCircuit, problem_qubits: list[int], ancilla_qubits: list[int]) -> None:
    # Define the edges of the graph
    edges = [(0, 2), (0, 3), (0, 4), (1, 2), (1, 3), (1, 4), (2, 3), (3, 4)]
    
    # Ancilla qubits for each edge
    ancillas = ancilla_qubits
    
    # Function to apply the color comparison for a single edge
    def compare_colors(qc, q1, q2, q3, q4, ancilla):
        # Compute part: ancilla = (q1 != q2) AND (q3 != q4)
        qc.cx(q1, ancilla)
        qc.cx(q2, ancilla)
        qc.ccx(q3, q4, ancilla)
        qc.cx(q3, ancilla)
        qc.cx(q4, ancilla)
        
        # Phase part: Z gate on ancilla if condition is true
        qc.cz(q1, ancilla)
        qc.cz(q2, ancilla)
        qc.ccz(q3, q4, ancilla)
        
        # Uncompute part: reverse the compute steps
        qc.cx(q4, ancilla)
        qc.cx(q3, ancilla)
        qc.ccx(q3, q4, ancilla)
        qc.cx(q2, ancilla)
        qc.cx(q1, ancilla)
    
    # Apply the oracle for each edge
    for i, (v1, v2) in enumerate(edges):
        q1 = problem_qubits[2 * v1]     # Low bit of vertex v1
        q2 = problem_qubits[2 * v1 + 1] # High bit of vertex v1
        q3 = problem_qubits[2 * v2]     # Low bit of vertex v2
        q4 = problem_qubits[2 * v2 + 1] # High bit of vertex v2
        ancilla = ancillas[i]
        
        compare_colors(qc, q1, q2, q3, q4, ancilla)

        # Offset 2: s2 s3 s4 s5

            qc.x(ancilla)

            qc.x(ancilla)
        
        # s2 ^ 0 (for offset 0, 1, 2)

    qc.cx(b0_0, a0)  # a0 = b0_0
